name: SVC_IOT_REG_REQS
description: This table is used to store registration requests from IOT cloud. REGISTRATION_REQ_ID is primary key in this table.

columns.name: REGISTRATION_REQ_ID
columns.description: Auto-generated number and primary key for this table.

columns.name: ORIGINAL_SYSTEM_REFERENCE
columns.description: Specifies the original system reference if record was imported.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: ASSET_ID
columns.description: CRM ASSET_ID corresponding to the device to be registered.

columns.name: DEVICE_UID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the device to be registered.

columns.name: SHARED_SECRET
columns.description: Activation Secret for the device to be registered. Should be ASCII printable characters.

columns.name: DEVICE_ID
columns.description: Stores IoT Cloud Service Device Id.

columns.name: DEVICE_NAME
columns.description: Name of the device to be registered.

columns.name: DEVICE_MANUFACTURER
columns.description: Stores Device manufacturer name.

columns.name: DEVICE_MODEL
columns.description: Stores model number of the device.

columns.name: DEVICE_SERIAL_NUMBER
columns.description: Stores serial number of the device.

columns.name: DEVICE_DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Stores description of the device.

columns.name: GPS_LATITUDE
columns.description: Stores GPS Latitude of the device.

columns.name: GPS_LONGITUDE
columns.description: Stores GPS Longitude of the device.

columns.name: GPS_ALTITUDE
columns.description: Stores GPS Altitude of the device.

columns.name: DEVICE_CREATION_STATUS
columns.description: Stores creation status of the device.

columns.name: DEVICE_CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Stores creation date of the device.

columns.name: DEVICE_REGISTRATION_STATUS
columns.description: Stores registration status of the device.

columns.name: DEVICE_REGITSRATION_DATE
columns.description: Stores registration date of the device.
